1.name: bug
1.description: Behaves wrongly; not a design question.

2.name: cleanup
2.description: Dead code, dead data, structure; no behaviour change intended.

3.name: client
3.description: Area: the game client (screens, rendering, input, client-side handling).

4.name: docs
4.description: A doc is wrong, stale or missing.

5.name: peer
5.description: Example tag for an issue another project's session sent; use peer_<project> per sender if you need to tell them apart.

7.name: test
7.description: Test setup, test kits, verification evidence.

9.name: server
9.description: Area: the game and login servers (handlers, world logic, networking).

10.name: shared
10.description: Code shared by client and server: protocol, wire structs, common headers.

11.name: database
11.description: sources/database: schema, generated DBs, version gate.
